name: my-crm
description: Provider-neutral CRM operations across tenant-scoped BOS-connected customer data sources.
long_description: My CRM gives authorized users one CRM operating vocabulary across connected customer and lead systems. GPT discovers Lead Director and its graph and API contracts through authenticated BOS app discovery for journey questions, preserves provenance and freshness, builds merged views, and uses the existing BOS domain-tool surface for compatibility workflows that have not migrated yet.
default_prompts: Show me the latest leads across my connected CRM sources.
Explain how you would find and merge this customer across my CRM sources.
Compare this customer across sources and show conflicts without changing anything.
